note: Skull Archfiend of Chaos bridges directly into the Light and Darkness Ritual engine — self-summons from hand or GY by bottom-decking 3 cards, and tutors a Ritual boss when it hits the GY.
Theorealize Past Lull Special Summons Medius the Pure from your hand or Deck while you control an Artmage, DoomZ, or Elfnote monster; Medius in turn searches or summons a Power Patron monster.

Headline wave — Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos reimagined as the Light and Darkness Ritual series (see full archetype guide), plus the new Black Chaos Pendulum monster, Celtic Mystic, Chaos Magical Hats, and Chaos Mystic Box.

Clown Crew Dristy, and Clown Crew Finale — mass destruction while you control a Tribute Summoned monster, or banish it from the GY and Tribute an Extra Deck/Ritual monster to search a Clown Crew of a different Level/Rank/Link.

A large wave: Aleister the Reminiscent, Invoked Baybarron, Invoked Oceanus, Invoked Sorath, Hyperinvoked Aeon, Invocation - "Sword", Gamma Summon, Sacred Spirit Sword Aiwass, Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law, and Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice.
New members: Melffy Godmommy, Melffy Rabbys, Melffy Footsteps, Melffy Playtime Surprise, and Melffys' Joyful Surprise.
Five new cards: The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak, Malevolent Scythe, Doomed Soleret, Umbrage Veil, and The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem.
Spiritual Power Recovery Potion (always treated as a "Possessed" card) — banishes Spellcasters/Spells from the GY for ATK and LP, and revives Spellcasters from the GY.
New members: Purification Power Patron, Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour, and Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea.
The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem headlines new support rewarding Xyz Summons of Xyz Dragon monsters, working directly with the Phantom Knights wave above.
Five new cards: S-Force Mystify, S-Force World Sorting, S-Force Signify, S-Force Nightcatcher, and S-Force Origin.
Foolish Trap Hole joins the Trap Hole series.
The arcade-reference series continues with cards like Gray Layer and Superconductive Plasma Blast.
